devin_session_cursors_pending_check.name: devin_session_cursors_pending_check
devin_session_cursors_pending_check.value: ("devin_session_cursors"."pending_assistant_content" IS NULL AND "devin_session_cursors"."pending_assistant_id" IS NULL AND "devin_session_cursors"."pending_assistant_at" IS NULL) OR ("devin_session_cursors"."pending_assistant_content" IS NOT NULL)

memories_suppressed_at_check.name: memories_suppressed_at_check
memories_suppressed_at_check.value: ("memories"."status" = 'suppressed' AND "memories"."suppressed_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("memories"."status" <> 'suppressed' AND "memories"."suppressed_at" IS NULL)

memories_deleted_at_check.name: memories_deleted_at_check
memories_deleted_at_check.value: ("memories"."status" = 'deleted' AND "memories"."deleted_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("memories"."status" <> 'deleted' AND "memories"."deleted_at" IS NULL)

memory_conflicts_resolution_metadata_che.name: memory_conflicts_resolution_metadata_check
memory_conflicts_resolution_metadata_che.value: ("memory_conflicts"."resolution" IS NULL AND "memory_conflicts"."resolved_at" IS NULL) OR ("memory_conflicts"."resolution" IS NOT NULL AND "memory_conflicts"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL)

memory_proposals_decision_metadata_check.name: memory_proposals_decision_metadata_check
memory_proposals_decision_metadata_check.value:
(
        "memory_proposals"."decision" IS NULL
        AND "memory_proposals"."reviewer_id" IS NULL
        AND "memory_proposals"."decision_reason" IS NULL
        AND "memory_proposals"."decided_at" IS NULL
        AND "memory_proposals"."decision_target_memory_id" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "memory_proposals"."decision" IS NOT NULL
        AND "memory_proposals"."reviewer_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "memory_proposals"."decision_reason" IS NOT NULL
        AND "memory_proposals"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND (
          ("memory_proposals"."decision" = 'use_proposal' AND "memory_proposals"."decision_target_memory_id" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("memory_proposals"."decision" <> 'use_proposal' AND "memory_proposals"."decision_target_memory_id" IS NULL)
        )
      )
